title: Slipstream Riddim
prompt: dance pop euro pop, uk garage, fast and high energy
description: A skippy UK garage 2-step that launches straight into shuffled hats and a punchy euclidean kick, building through two sweat-soaked peak moments separated by a stripped, haunting breakdown.
